name: Update Center
author: Saiiiiiph
description: One quiet indicator for pending system, AUR, Flatpak, and Omarchy plugin updates.

barWidget.description: Checks system, AUR, Flatpak, and Git-managed Omarchy plugin updates. It never installs automatically.

schema.label: Check for updates
schema.description: A check always runs when Omarchy starts. Choose how often it repeats during the session.

schema.label: Offer shutdown after updates
schema.description: Show Update & shut down and Shut down anyway while updates are pending.
